name: Introduction and overview — Seawolf-class Submarine — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Seawolf-class Submarine
description: Introduction and overview of the Seawolf-class Submarine: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Seawolf class — only three built — was designed as the ultimate Cold War hunter: faster, deeper, and quieter than anything before, with eight torpedo tubes and 50 weapons. The Cold War's end cut the planned 29-boat fleet to three; the class remains the most capable attack submarine ever built. Baseline facts: U.S. attack submarine; 3 built; fastest/deepest/quietest; 8 tubes, 50 weapons..
